title: Which hyperPad App Should You Download?
summary: Choose hyperPad Starter, the paid hyperPad app, or hyperPad Hub based on whether you want to build, share, export, or play Projects.
body_markdown:
Choose the hyperPad app that matches your next task. Use **hyperPad Starter** to build and test one Project for free. Choose the paid **hyperPad** app when you need a larger creation workflow, Hub sharing, or Xcode Export. Use **hyperPad Hub** when your main goal is to play and discover community Projects.


The current hyperPad products are not subscriptions. Check each App Store listing for current compatibility and availability.


*Product boundaries reviewed October 21, 2026.*


## Quick decision table


Your next task Choose Why


Build a first playable mechanic hyperPad Starter Free, ad-free access to one editable Project and the visual creation workflow


Keep several Projects, share to the Hub, or prepare an Xcode Export hyperPad The paid creation app supports the broader production and publishing workflow


Play and discover community Projects hyperPad Hub Focused on community play and discovery rather than editing


## hyperPad Starter


[hyperPad Starter](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hyperpad-starter/id6737631128) is the free starting point. It is designed for building and testing one editable Project.


Use it to learn:


- Scenes and Objects
- importing graphics and audio
- visual Behaviors
- Attributes and state
- physics, input, UI, and feedback
- playtesting in the editor


The[How to Use hyperPad](https://www.hyperpad.com/blog/how-to-use-hyperpad) tutorial gives you a small first-game workflow. The[Behavior Interface Overview](https://www.hyperpad.com/documentation/behavior-interface-overview) explains the visual logic editor.


## The paid hyperPad app


Choose the[paid hyperPad app](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hyperpad-ipad-game-maker/id886106438) when one Project is no longer enough or when you need production features tied to the complete workflow.


Current product information identifies:


- multiple-Project creation
- Project sharing through the Hub
- Xcode Export for the Apple publishing workflow
- creation on supported iPads and compatible Apple-silicon Macs


Xcode Export is not direct App Store submission. Preparing and submitting the build still requires a compatible Mac, Xcode, an Apple Developer account, and App Store Connect.


## hyperPad Hub


The[hyperPad Hub](https://www.hyperpad.com/hub) is where you can discover and play shared community Projects. It is useful when you want inspiration, want to observe how another creator explains a mechanic, or want to follow community activity.


If you want to edit a Project, choose one of the creation apps instead.


## A simple way to decide


Start with Starter if you have not built the core mechanic yet. Move to the paid app when the Project or publishing workflow requires it. Use Hub alongside the creation app when community play and feedback become part of the process.


That sequence keeps the first decision small and ties each download to a job you actually need to do.
